d: Can world cricket force Afghanistan to change? Scotland's decision to restrict bilateral cricket with Afghanistan after the likes of Australia and England has forced us to look beyond the men's game. While Afghanistan's cricketers continue to compete on the international stage, its women remain shut out of the sport under Taliban rule. Rupha Ramani decodes the pressure on the ICC, the plight of Afghan women cricketers in exile and the difficult question of how far cricket's governing bodies are willing to go.
